Cottage in Heart of East Nashville
Nestled in the peaceful, family-friendly South Inglewood neighborhood, this cozy 3-bedroom, 2-bath upper suite offers the perfect retreat for those looking to experience the charm of East Nashville. With a fully stocked kitchen, you have everything you need to feel right at home.
Enjoy a short walk to local eateries and coffee spots, or take a 10-minute drive to the iconic Grand Ole Opry. Whatever you're in town for this guest suite provides the ideal home base
